technical.title: Research reveals optimal layer-module pairs improve vision foundation model representations.
technical.summary: Evaluating vision foundation models across 144,000 linear probings shows that considering layer and module choices jointly yields substantially larger gains than probing final layers alone.
technical.why: It helps computer vision engineers extract better feature representations from foundational models.

technical.title: MBZUAI releases PAN 2 open world model for physical AI.
technical.summary: MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models released PAN 2, an Apache 2.0 world model coupling an LLM planner with a 29B diffusion transformer to simulate action outcomes as video.
technical.why: It provides a new open model for autonomous driving and physical AI simulation.

technical.title: Evolving Infra framework adapts LLM serving compute and KV cache.
technical.summary: Evolving Infra is an agent-adaptive serving framework that decouples compute allocation from key-value cache management, resolving load imbalances and cache evictions caused by dynamic agent workloads.
technical.why: It addresses infrastructure bottlenecks for scaling agentic LLM workloads.

technical.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
technical.summary: Built primarily on OpenAI models, Amplitude’s proactive product agent, Wave, identifies what to build, helps teams ship changes with coding agents, and measures the impact.

technical.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
AWS releases AWS Emulator built entirely by autonomous agents.
technical.summary: AWS released a CC0-licensed local emulator of AWS APIs written entirely by autonomous agents, passing over 56 percent of published fidelity tests at launch.
technical.why: It showcases practical applications of autonomous agents in software engineering.

technical.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
technical.summary: Meet the Gemini Decisions API, powered by our state-of-the-art model Gemini Decision for fast, calibrated multimodal decisions.

business.title: Jensen Huang's resignation raises questions about Nvidia open source
business.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia, creating a leadership transition that places the company's commitment to open source AI, including its Hugging Face acquisition and open-weight models, in question.

business.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO after board investigation
business.summary: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO following a board investigation into multiple extramarital affairs with a direct report and an alleged Chinese spy, with Harvey Jones stepping in as the first Chair of the Board.

business.title: Ukrainian defense tech startup UFORCE hits $6 billion valuation
business.summary: UFORCE's NEMESIS drones completed 300,000 combat flights and its MAGURA naval vessels destroyed Russian warships, driving a $6 billion valuation as investors bet on battle-tested drones.
business.why: It shows how active military conflict accelerates high valuations for autonomous drone hardware and computer vision applications.

business.title: Hugging Face CEO vows to fight for open source
business.summary: Following Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia, Hugging Face's CEO pledged to keep fighting for open source AI, raising fresh questions about Nvidia's $12.9 billion acquisition.

business.title: Nvidia partner Megaspeed faces probe over restricted chip shipments
business.summary: Megaspeed is central to a U.S. probe investigating its role in sending billions of dollars of restricted Nvidia chips to China, alongside executive relationships tied to Jensen Huang.

business.title: Nvidia confirmed chip tracking is technically possible for anti-smuggling
business.summary: Nvidia representatives told U.S. Representative Bill Foster that implementing anti-smuggling measures called for in the Chip Security Act is technically possible, despite industry claims that tracking was infeasible.

business.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid multiple affairs investigations
business.summary: Following initial disclosures regarding Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, investigations revealed evidence of another affair with an Nvidia executive reporting directly to Jensen Huang, leading to his resignation.

business.title: Nebius plans $40 billion spending for AI infrastructure expansion
business.summary: Nebius plans to fund a $40 billion AI infrastructure expansion through customer prepayments and loans. Meanwhile, delays at a Microsoft data center raise questions about this financing model.

business.title: VCs Are Still Chasing Protein, Even As Fake Meat Falls Out Of Favor

models.title: New open-source model introduced for state-of-the-art image generation and editing
models.summary: MiniMax-H3-Image is a state-of-the-art open-source model from the MiniMax H3 family that handles image generation, editing, and prompt expansion with precise instruction following.
models.why: It offers computer vision engineers a new open-source tool for advanced image synthesis and manipulation workflows.

models.title: New tool converts single images into 3D Gaussian splats rapidly
models.summary: Idol turns a single input image into up to 1,048,576 3D Gaussians written as a standard 3DGS .ply file, removing backgrounds and generating unseen sides in under 2 seconds on consumer GPUs.
models.why: It enables rapid 3D asset reconstruction from single images, which is valuable for computer vision and 3D pipelines.

models.title: Repackaged image generation model files released for ComfyUI integration
models.summary: This repository provides repackaged model files and directory structures to run MiniMax H3 Image directly inside ComfyUI, alongside recommended text encoders.
models.why: It simplifies local pipeline integration for vision engineers using ComfyUI for image generation workflows.

models.title: Multimodal agentic model released with a 1-million-token context window
models.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model featuring a 2.8T total parameter MoE architecture, a 1-million-token context window, and improvements in coding and 3D creation.
models.why: Its native multimodality and massive context window offer robust capabilities for complex agentic and 3D creation tasks.

models.title: Small language model preview explores general coding and 3D scene generation
models.summary: This independent early preview fine-tune based on Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B explores the feasibility of small language models for general-purpose coding and interactive 3D scene generation using Three.js.
models.why: It highlights early experiments in pushing small models to handle specialized 3D code generation tasks.

models.title: Preview of 65B dense transformer model released with massive context window
models.summary: Ricursive Intelligence introduces Ripple-65B Preview, a 65B parameter dense model pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1Mi context, scoring 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1.
models.why: It delivers strong agentic coding performance that outpaces much larger open-weight models.
